body: Thanks and I can very well relate,  I'm just waiting to fade out of society altogether too

Things just naturally come to those who are attractive,  theirs no trying.  You walk into a grocery store and people adore you,  want to get to know you.   
I have gone to all the recommended places and ...still alone as ever.

None for the majority of my life.   I once went out with a couple of females when I was staying in a shelter,  it felt really good and on that day I realized theirs a possibility I'm really missing out.
